title: UIAO Directory Migration Adapter Registry Schema
description: JSON Schema for src/uiao/modernization/directory-migration/migration-adapter-registry.yaml. This registry catalogs the eight AD-dependent infrastructure adapters (DM_010 through DM_090) that govern the Active Directory infrastructure bridge per docs/modernization/directory-migration.qmd. Distinct from src/uiao/schemas/adapter-registry/adapter-registry.schema.json which validates the modernization/conformance adapter registry (UIAO_003 doctrinal segmentation). The Phase 2 introduction of this schema (ADR-081) declares the migration_phase enum as the canonical six-phase model (Discover, Normalize, Map, Migrate, Validate, Decommission) plus the documented opt-out 'N/A — net-new capability' for adapters that add capability without retiring legacy infrastructure. Today the schema is declarative (no runtime validator wired); future ADR work will gate the YAML against this schema in CI.

registry_type.description: Pins this registry document to the directory-migration registry class. Other registry classes (modernization, conformance) are governed by separate schemas.

version.description: Semantic major.minor version of this registry document.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime when this registry was first authored.

owner.description: Human-readable owner accountable for the registry's content.

adapters.description: Ordered list of directory-migration adapter entries.

core_canon_touchpoints.description: Cross-references from migration adapters to UIAO_xxx core canon documents. Used for traceability between the AD-migration adapter layer and the substrate canon.

adapter_id.description: Kebab-case stable identifier. Never renamed once assigned.

document_id.description: DM_NNN canonical document identifier for the adapter interface specification.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the adapter interface document, relative to src/uiao/modernization/directory-migration/.

priority.description: Risk-tier priority per the canon page's CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM bands.

risk_class.description: Short human-readable description of the failure mode if this adapter's migration is not handled correctly.

core_concepts.description: Core-concept anchors this adapter is grounded in. Format: '#N Concept Name' matching the eight universal core concepts.

implementations.description: Vendor-specific implementations registered under this adapter interface.

migration_phase.description: Per ADR-081, the canonical six-phase Directory Migration model that every adapter follows: Discover → Normalize → Map → Migrate → Validate → Decommission. Each adapter declares its CURRENT phase (the phase it is presently executing or has most recently completed). The opt-out value 'N/A — net-new capability' is reserved for adapters that add capability without retiring any legacy infrastructure (i.e., Phase 6 Decommission is not applicable to their migration program). Field is optional today; expected to become required when ADR-081 Phase 5 (adapter-template / contributor guidance) lands and the registry is fully backfilled.

id.description: Kebab-case implementation identifier scoped within the parent adapter.

vendor.description: Originating vendor or 'Any' for vendor-neutral implementations.

fedramp_authorized.description: True when the implementation carries a current FedRAMP authorization at a boundary that satisfies the registry's GCC-Moderate scope.

federal_preferred.description: True when the implementation is the recommended choice for federal-tenant deployments under this adapter interface.

dm_adapter.description: adapter_id of the directory-migration adapter participating in the touchpoint.

core_doc.description: UIAO_NNN identifier of the core canon document the adapter touches.

relationship.description: Free-text description of how the adapter relates to the core canon document.
